title: Build system: Linking + binary size validation
acceptance_criteria: Makefile links assembly objects with C library objects into final binary
Linked binary executes without segfault (prints hello or exits cleanly)
Binary size is measured and reported during build
Build fails with warning if binary exceeds 500KB threshold
Linker script or flags strip debug symbols and unused sections
Running 'make size-check' reports binary size and RAM estimate
deliverables: Makefile (updated with linking rules and size-check target)
